اعتزلا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَلَا (iʕtazalā) /iʕ.ta.za.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اُعْتُزِلَا (uʕtuzilā) /uʕ.tu.zi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اِعْتَزِلَا (iʕtazilā) /iʕ.ta.zi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
